title: Port the provided PHP/MySQL signup + wallet funding behavior to Internet Identity + Motoko admin wallet

requirements.text: Implement a backend onboarding API that mirrors the provided PHP logic: when an authenticated user is new (no existing balance record), allocate an initial balance of 10 PKR to that user by deducting 10 PKR from the single admin wallet within the same backend call. If the admin wallet balance is less than 10 PKR, the call must fail without changing either balance and return a clear English error message (e.g., "Admin balance not enough!").

quotes: $initialBalance = 10; ... if($admin['balance'] >= $initialBalance){ ... Deduct admin balance ... } else { $error = "Admin balance not enough!"; }

acceptanceCriteria: Given a signed-in user with no prior balance record, calling the onboarding API credits the user with 10 PKR and deducts 10 PKR from the admin wallet atomically.
Given a signed-in user who already has a balance record, calling the onboarding API does not change balances and succeeds (idempotent).
Given admin wallet balance < 10 PKR, calling the onboarding API fails and neither admin wallet nor user balance changes.
The error surfaced from the backend is in English and matches/contains the meaning of "Admin balance not enough!".

requirements.text: Persist the admin wallet balance and per-user balances in stable canister state so that balances are not reset after canister upgrades/redeploys (equivalent to the provided SQL example where the admin row starts at 10000 and changes persist). Add a conditional migration only if needed to preserve existing deployed state.

quotes: UPDATE admin SET balance = balance - $initialBalance WHERE id=1

acceptanceCriteria: Admin wallet initial value remains 10,000 PKR only for a fresh install; after distributions/onboarding allocations, the resulting balance persists across upgrades.
User balances (including the new-user 10 PKR initial allocation) persist across upgrades.
If prior state exists, upgrading does not wipe balances; any required migration is conditional and preserves existing values.

requirements.text: Add a frontend flow that calls the new onboarding API after a user signs in (Internet Identity) so new users automatically receive the initial 10 PKR allocation (when available), and returning users are not re-credited. If onboarding fails due to insufficient admin funds, show an English error toast/message and keep the displayed balances unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: After signing in as a never-before-seen Principal, the UI triggers onboarding and the BalanceIndicator updates to show +10 PKR without a full page refresh.
After signing in as an existing user, the onboarding call does not change the user’s balance.
If onboarding fails due to insufficient admin funds, the UI shows an English error (toast or inline) and does not change any displayed balances.

requirements.text: Add a React Query mutation/hook for the onboarding API alongside the existing wallet hooks, and ensure successful onboarding invalidates/refetches the existing balance queries so BalanceIndicator updates immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: A new React Query hook exists for onboarding/initial funding and is used by the sign-in flow.
On success, the hook invalidates/refetches at minimum the caller balance query (and admin wallet query when applicable) so UI updates immediately.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not add or depend on MySQL, PHP sessions, or any external database; persistence must be done using stable Motoko canister state.
Keep all Motoko logic in the single main actor (backend/main.mo).
Only create a migration file/logic if it is required to preserve existing deployed state (conditional migration policy).
Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths (e.g., useActor/useInternetIdentity/main.tsx/components/ui).
nonGoals: Implementing password-based signup/login (password hashing, sessions) like the PHP example; authentication remains Internet Identity.
Building an Express/PHP server or server-rendered pages like signup.php/dashboard.php/logout.php.
Adding third-party auth providers or external wallet integrations.
